verification.validation: Compose planner tests pass as a non-root user (UID 65534): a model of DSM's quote-dropping rewrite of the worker file (every scalar re-emitted unquoted) is loaded by the pinned compose-go loader, and command, entrypoint, exec-form healthcheck test, environment and label values such as 10, 0755, true, yes, null, ~, 1e3, 0x1F, 1_000, 0o17, .5, on, +1, 1:20, .inf and 0b101 come back as the same strings; the worker file without the rewrite loads the same values. The vaultwarden and immich fixtures keep byte-identical worker file, override and lock; the openlist fixture changes only its UMASK 022 value. Both npm packages are built and packed for content scans. No full gate matrix, qemu, publication or NAS acceptance is implied.

changes: Keep quoted numeric-looking strings in Compose (command, entrypoint, healthcheck test, environment, labels and other string positions) as strings after DSM rewrites the worker file without quotes, by deferring them to Compose interpolation.
Keep canonical integers and true/false unchanged where the Compose schema accepts a number or boolean, so Apps without numeric-looking strings keep the same worker file, override and lock.
